annotationRationale: AA similarity gives the side and squared area ratios. Shared-height triangle comparisons and subtraction of component areas determine the quadrilateral's area, using parallelogram properties and base-height formulas.
sourceMethod: Follows the official AA-similarity and area-unit solution. It explicitly identifies the equal angles and explains why triangle ABE has one-fourth of the parallelogram's area.

review.mathCheck: Let the parallelogram's area be S. Similarity gives AF:FC=1:2, hence [CFB]=S/3. Also [ABE]=S/4, leaving [CDEF]=S-S/3-S/4=5S/12. The ratio is 5:4, choice A. The supplied figure confirms the nonoverlapping partition.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of MAA solution 10, pages 4–5: AA similarity, area units 1, 4 and 2, then subtraction from 12. The quarter-area explanation makes the official observation reconstructible.
review.annotationCheck: The rationale and assessed/support assignments match the worked method. No material omission or incorrect direct node.

nativeLayerJudgments.CN: The exact links cover similarity criteria and properties, composite-area subtraction, parallelogram properties, and triangle/parallelogram area formulas. All six nodes apply.
nativeLayerJudgments.US: G-SRT.B.5 directly supports the similarity application. The AA portions of 8.G.A.5 and G-SRT.A.2/.3 are relevant, but their criterion-establishment or transformation requirements are not demonstrated. G-CO.C.11 supplies parallelogram facts, without proving them. cnm_272 has no accepted US link.
